name: claude-usage-bar
description: Shows your Claude Code rate limit usage in the VS Code status bar via statusLine integration — session %, reset countdown, and color alerts. Zero API calls.

enumDescriptions: Show both session and weekly limits
claudeUsageBar.displayMode.description: Which rate limit to display in the status bar

enumDescriptions: Progress bar on session and weekly
Progress bar on session only, weekly as percentage
Progress bar on weekly only, session as percentage
claudeUsageBar.progressBar.description: Which limits show a visual progress bar next to the percentage

claudeUsageBar.showProgressBar.description: Show a visual progress bar next to the percentage.
claudeUsageBar.showProgressBar.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `#claudeUsageBar.progressBar#` instead. Still honoured until `progressBar` is set.

claudeUsageBar.showSessionInfo.description: Show the active Claude model and context size (e.g. 'Opus 5.5 · Ctx 80K') for this workspace's latest Claude session

commands.title: Claude Usage: Switch Display Mode (Session / Weekly / Both)
